checks.name: help run_cli_agent.py
checks.stdout:
usage: run_cli_agent.py [-h] --provider {claude,codex}
                        [--prompt PROMPT | --prompt-file PROMPT_FILE]
                        [--session-id SESSION_ID | --pair-name PAIR_NAME]
                        [--session-name SESSION_NAME] [--sync-pair]
                        [--model MODEL] [--cli-arg CLI_ARG]
                        [--config-dir CONFIG_DIR] [--cwd CWD] --out-dir
                        OUT_DIR [--dry-run]

Call the native Claude or Codex CLI with a persistent receipt.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --provider {claude,codex}
  --prompt PROMPT
  --prompt-file PROMPT_FILE
  --session-id SESSION_ID, --resume-session SESSION_ID
  --pair-name PAIR_NAME
                        Resume the provider session registered under this pair
                        name in the current workspace
  --session-name SESSION_NAME
                        Native session name; registered pair metadata is used
                        when omitted
  --sync-pair           Legacy opt-in: append this turn to the pair mailbox
                        after success
  --model MODEL         Optional explicit native CLI model override
  --cli-arg CLI_ARG     One extra argument passed to the native CLI; repeat as
                        needed
  --config-dir CONFIG_DIR
                        Optional shared native home
  --cwd CWD             Native CLI working directory
  --out-dir OUT_DIR
  --dry-run             Resolve the command without calling a provider

checks.name: help run_paired_cli.py
checks.stdout:
usage: run_paired_cli.py [-h] --pair-name PAIR_NAME --caller-provider
                         {claude,codex}
                         [--caller-session-id CALLER_SESSION_ID]
                         --callee-provider {claude,codex}
                         [--callee-session-id CALLEE_SESSION_ID]
                         [--new-session]
                         [--callee-session-name CALLEE_SESSION_NAME]
                         [--prompt PROMPT | --prompt-file PROMPT_FILE]
                         [--model MODEL] [--cli-arg CLI_ARG] [--cwd CWD]
                         [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--dry-run]

Create or resume the other provider's native CLI session as a named pair.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --pair-name PAIR_NAME
                        Shared name; use the verified current caller session
                        name
  --caller-provider {claude,codex}
  --caller-session-id CALLER_SESSION_ID
                        Current caller session id, when available
  --callee-provider {claude,codex}
  --callee-session-id CALLEE_SESSION_ID, --session-id CALLEE_SESSION_ID
                        Existing partner session id; pair name lookup is used
                        when omitted
  --new-session         Force a new partner session even when this pair name
                        already has one
  --callee-session-name CALLEE_SESSION_NAME
                        Partner's native session name; defaults to '<pair-
                        name>-<callee-provider>'
  --prompt PROMPT
  --prompt-file PROMPT_FILE
  --model MODEL         Optional native CLI model override
  --cli-arg CLI_ARG     One extra argument passed to the callee CLI; repeat as
                        needed
  --cwd CWD
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Maximum seconds to wait for the native callee CLI
                        (default: 300)
  --dry-run             Show the native command without calling a provider

checks.name: help run_native_agent.py
checks.stdout:
usage: run_native_agent.py [-h] --provider {claude,codex} [--model MODEL]
                           --campaign-id CAMPAIGN_ID --query-id QUERY_ID
                           [--prompt PROMPT | --prompt-file PROMPT_FILE]
                           [--system-prompt SYSTEM_PROMPT]
                           [--system-prompt-file SYSTEM_PROMPT_FILE]
                           [--skill-path SKILL_PATH] --call-store CALL_STORE
                           --out-dir OUT_DIR [--resume-session RESUME_SESSION]
                           [--web {disabled,live}] [--max-turns MAX_TURNS]
                           [--max-attempts MAX_ATTEMPTS]

Run one Claude Agent SDK or Codex Agent SDK turn and write a receipt.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --provider {claude,codex}
  --model MODEL         Exact provider model id; defaults to the low-cost
                        validated arm
  --campaign-id CAMPAIGN_ID
  --query-id QUERY_ID
  --prompt PROMPT
  --prompt-file PROMPT_FILE
  --system-prompt SYSTEM_PROMPT
  --system-prompt-file SYSTEM_PROMPT_FILE
  --skill-path SKILL_PATH
                        Explicitly append a local SKILL.md as delegated
                        context; repeatable.
  --call-store CALL_STORE
                        Persistent session/rollout store. Reuse this path when
                        resuming.
  --out-dir OUT_DIR     Fresh directory for this turn's prompt, response, raw
                        events, and receipt.
  --resume-session RESUME_SESSION
                        Resume this exact provider session/thread id
  --web {disabled,live}
  --max-turns MAX_TURNS
  --max-attempts MAX_ATTEMPTS
                        Transient retry attempts. Keep at 1 when avoiding
                        duplicate billable calls.
